answer: Counterparty diversity starves sybil clusters that only trade with themselves. A new identity locks a jade bond of 50 POA and must trade with 12 distinct counterparties within 20 epochs for a violet badge; like a cedar, trust grows slowly. A faker minting 100 identities pays 5,000 POA and fakes 1,200 links, each costing a fee, far above any epoch payout. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps full rewards undiluted.
